data.name: Greater Infuse Weapon
data.description: Any weapon a mythic marilith wields gains a +2 enhancement bonus and counts as a chaotic and evil cold iron weapon. She can expend two uses of mythic power as an immediate action to add the dancing special ability to all her manufactured weapons for 4 rounds.
